referral.merchant_message: Customer's card keeps getting declined at the till. Can you tell us why?

steps.text: I'll investigate this referral by looking up the merchant, transaction, and card status.
Now let me check the card status to confirm:
The investigation is clear. The transaction was declined because the card (ending in 4417) has expired. The card status confirms it expired in September 2026.

input.message_to_merchant: The card was declined because it has expired. Please ask your customer to use a different card or to contact their card issuer to request a replacement.
